pr.title: Write BRC history and remove drafts in PR phase (#1599)
pr.description:
Adds a safety net for BRC history files in the PR phase by re-writing
history for all completed phases before PR creation. Also removes
pipeline draft files from the branch to keep PR diffs clean.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: test_brc_history.py tests for PR-phase BRC re-write
- Automated: new tests for _cleanup_drafts_for_pr scoping and no-op behavior
- Manual: Run a pipeline and verify BRC history files appear in the PR and draft files do not
